periods.title: Review periods
periods.hint: The global timeline performance reviews attach to. Periods are appended without gaps — the next period starts right after the latest one ends — and are immutable; only the latest, unused period can be deleted.

periods.startLocked: Fixed — the timeline allows no gaps or overlaps: a new period starts right after the latest one ends.
periods.adjacencyConflict: The period must start right after the latest one ends — reload and try again.
periods.invalidMonths: Both months are required, and the first month cannot be after the last.
periods.deleteConflict: Only the latest period without any reviews can be deleted.
periods.deleteMessage: The latest period will be removed from the timeline.
